**Interview Experience:**

I was directly applying to all the jobs I saw on LinkedIn. One day, I got a call from an HR representative. She informed me about the interview rounds.

Round 1: Screening Round (Elimination Round)
Two medium-level DSA (Data Structures and Algorithms) questions were asked.

After that, the HR informed me that there would be three more rounds, and the final feedback would be shared at the end.

Round 2: (45 minutes)
Again, two DSA questions were asked. Both were at an easy-to-medium level and related to string manipulation. I was able to answer them.

Round 3: (45 minutes)
This round went well. I was asked one DSA question, followed by questions related to my resume, some LLD (Low-Level Design), and HLD (High-Level Design) topics. Overall, it was manageable.

Round 4: Bar Raiser Round
This was a deep dive into my resume. I was asked detailed questions about Redis, my past work experience, and reasons behind certain decisions. There were also some behavioral questions.

A few days later, I received an offer.
